custom_label_0

The value for a custom label of a product item, hotel, destination, vehicle, or home listing.

The value is treated as a string. Numeric operators (gt, gte, lt, lte) are not available on this field. Instead, you should use the custom_number_0 field, which supports integers.

Added [partner-initiated WABA creation](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/overview) to replace the [On-Behalf-Of](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/obo-model-deprecation) ("OBO") account ownership model, which is [being deprecated](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/obo-model-deprecation). The old `share` attachment type will continue to be supported for Instagram posts until **February 1, 2026**, after which it will be removed. Partners and integrators are encouraged to migrate to the new `ig_post` attachment type
